declarations.name: showXLabel
declarations.description: Skip crowded x-axis labels so month names stay legible without overlapping.

declarations.name: booleanAttribute
declarations.default: { fromAttribute(value: string | null): boolean { return value !== null && value.toLowerCase() !== "false"; }, toAttribute(value: boolean): string | null { return value ? "" : null; }, }

declarations.name: dataAttribute
declarations.default: { fromAttribute(value: string | null): LoomiChartPoint[] { if (!value) return []; try { const parsed = JSON.parse(value); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : []; } catch { return []; } }, toAttribute(value: LoomiChartPoint[]): string { return JSON.stringify(value); }, }

declarations.name: groupedSeriesLabels
declarations.description: Stable series order — first-seen label wins (e.g. Mike, Sam, Fred, Sara).

declarations.name: barSeriesCount
declarations.description: Bar groups per x-axis category — `values` arrays or legacy `value`/`value2`/`value3`.

declarations.name: tooltipAnchor
declarations.description: Pixel anchor for a cartesian tooltip — band center x, top of the hovered category.

declarations.name: roundedTopRectPath
declarations.description: Draws a rect-like path with rounded top corners and square bottom corners.

declarations.name: roundedTopRectBorderPath
declarations.description: Open path for a bar border — no bottom edge (sits on the axis).

declarations.name: hoverTargets

type.text: { showYAxis: boolean; vertical: boolean; donutRadius: number }

declarations.description: Hover regions aligned to chart geometry — cartesian types use full bands for crosshair-style tooltips.

declarations.name: nearestIndex
declarations.description: Nearest data index from a pointer position (0–1) along the primary axis.

`<loomi-chart>` — SVG charts inspired by shadcn/ui and Untitled UI: `bar`, `line`,
`area`, `pie`, `donut`, `radar`, `radial`, `scatter`, or `heatmap`. Pass a single series via
`data` (`{ label, value, color? }`).
